query: Only optional limit, integer 1..50, default25; unknown, duplicate, empty, malformed or out-of-range query parameters return400. The limit applies independently to each entity kind, not to the whole project.

nodes.id: entity ID; opaque composite for receipt/session/memory-version
nodes.label: untrusted display text, render as text only
nodes.meta: allowlisted metadata object; no content bodies

groups.total: exact authorized count in this snapshot

RelationType.project_member: project -> visible project account; not an access-level inventory
RelationType.project_contains: project -> entity with an explicit project reference
RelationType.channel_member: included account -> included channel, existing scoped membership; no grant level
RelationType.receipt_for: message -> recipient delivery-status record, including records not yet confirmed
RelationType.reported_message: native report -> explicitly referenced message in that same visible channel
RelationType.review_request: run/event -> referenced review_requested event of the same task and run
RelationType.evidence_ref: event -> explicitly referenced same-project evidence-role artifact
RelationType.source_message: note -> explicitly referenced message, only when source channel remains visible

identity: Clients must not parse keys or composite IDs. Receipt identity is (message_id,agent_id); execution-session identity is (project_id,agent_id,session_id); memory-version identity is (memory_id,exact integer version). Use metadata fields for navigation. agent type includes account kinds agent/viewer/owner subject to project visibility, not only model-running agents.
authorization: Current principal key and kind are rechecked inside one read-only repeatable-read transaction, followed by current project read ACL. Owner may read archived project history. Ordinary visible accounts follow the existing shared-readable-channel /agents rule. Channel/message/receipt/native/session data and counts require each channel to be visible. Tasks/runs/events/artifacts/memory/versions/notes are shared project data. Unknown and forbidden project return404; invalid/revoked key401. Note source_message_id is null when its source channel is hidden; source IDs are not leaked through metadata or dangling edges.
bounds: Five-second snapshot timeout. One count-window metadata query per kind, not one request/query per task/message/version. At most 1+13*limit nodes (651 at limit50). Every edge joins two actual included nodes. Per-kind sampling is latest timestamp then stable ID; account/channel lack a creation timestamp and use stable ID order. Independent sampling may omit relation endpoints: absence of an edge does not prove absence of a relationship. Counts are for authorized data, not the entire workspace. Recipient and artifact-ref arrays inherit API cap32; channel membership edges are queried only between included capped accounts and channels.
privacy: No message/note/memory body, artifact bytes, full task payload, summary, criteria/scope paths, verification command, raw activity self-report, key, key hash or artifact hash. Display names and titles remain untrusted text; never interpret as markup or commands. No new schema, persisted graph, audit event, heartbeat or receipt mutation.
non_relations: ExecutionSession.run_id is a caller-provided run/listener-generation label; equality with TaskRun.id does not create a relationship.
Native CLI session correlation, execution-session lease and legacy heartbeat/receipt session are independent; matching strings do not connect them.
Published memory and selected browser memory_refs do not imply any task or CLI used that memory. No invented task-memory links.
Artifact hash/base revision equality is not a parent/child relationship, task attachment, verification or correctness proof.
Task state/review/evidence are attributed external claims; native completion does not prove task completion. Session expiry alone does not establish freshness or model activity.
Service keys, live grant administration and audit are conceptual explanations only; this response is not an owner credential/access inventory or process-control surface.
